chosenEdition.name: Harper Perennial Modern Classics edition
chosenEdition.sourceProvenance: Authorized preview metadata from Google Books plus WorldCat/Open Library catalog confirmation

decision.reason: The main English editions visible in Open Library and WorldCat preserve the same ten-chapter structure. The 2008 Harper Perennial Modern Classics edition is the clearest currently indexed English working edition with a full chapter map and subheading signal, while remaining chapter-level consistent with the 1990 first edition. No material chapter-order or chapter-scope ambiguity was found, so user intervention was unnecessary.
